---

Data: [palmerpenguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/),
Palmer Station Antarctica LTER, available via the `palmerpenguins`
Python package (CC0 licence).

```{python}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

penguins = load_penguins()
penguins = penguins.dropna()
```

A quick look at the data:

```{python}
penguins.head()
```

Average body mass by species:

```{python}
summary = penguins.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].mean().round(1)
summary
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-penguin-mass-py
#| fig-cap: "Average body mass (g) by penguin species."
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
summary.plot(kind="bar", ax=ax)
ax.set_ylabel("Body mass (g)")
ax.set_xlabel("Species")
plt.show()
```

Gentoo penguins are noticeably heavier on average than Adelie or
Chinstrap penguins in this dataset.
